newsitem.title: USA: Culligan completes new credit facilities.
newsitem.headline: Culligan completes new credit facilities.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said it completed new credit facilities.
The facilities consist of a five-year, $200 million multi-currency revolving credit facility and a $100 million 364-day multi-currency revolving credit facility with a four year term-out option.

Culligan said the new credit facilities will replace a $150 million reducing revolving credit facility entered into in July 1995 in connection with its spin-off from its former parent. The new facilities are expected to reduce borrowing costs and offer greater borrowing flexibility, it added.
"The new credit facilities enhance our already strong financial position and offer us a strong resource for strategic growth," Michael Salvati, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
On Wednesday, Culligan reported first quarter operating earnings of $1.22 a share before a $0.02 charge, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.17 a share.
Sales rose to $99.4 million from $83.4 million.
About half the growth in sales was due to acquisitions, with the balance coming from internal growth, the company said.
Culligan makes and distributes water purification and treatment products.
